title: MissionDefinitionDef
description:
A mission definition from JSON type `"mission_definition"`.

Defines a quest/mission that can be given to the player by NPCs or started automatically. Missions have goals, difficulty, rewards, and start/end effects.

deadline.description: Deadline (if timed) - can be a number, string, array, or math expression.

dialogue.description: NPC dialogue that starts this mission.

end.description: End conditions / effects that trigger when the mission is completed.

fail.description: Fail conditions / effects that trigger when the mission is failed.

follows.description: Whether an NPC follows the player for this mission.

goal_condition.description: Condition for the goal to be achieved.

has_generic_rewards.description: Whether the mission is selected automatically upon accepting.

hidden.description: Whether the mission should be hidden from the player.

origins.description: NPC origins that can give this mission (e.g. ["ORIGIN_GAME_START", "ORIGIN_SECONDARY"]).

remove.description: Items to remove from the player when the mission is completed.

start.description: Start conditions / effects that trigger when the mission is accepted.

start_npc.description: ID of the NPC that starts this mission.

value.description: Monetary value / reward (numeric, map, or array).

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
